measurement.applicationBytes: Logical authenticated RTC frame payload; excludes framing headers/credit and SCTP/DTLS/IP overhead.
measurement.rtcSdpBytes: UTF-8 bytes of the complete offer and answer SDP descriptions.
measurement.rtcSignalingRequestBytes: Actual direct introduction HTTP request bodies, including the protocol JSON envelope; excludes HTTP headers.
measurement.rtcSignalingResponseBytes: Actual direct introduction HTTP response bodies, including the protocol JSON envelope; excludes HTTP headers.

native.byteBoundary: Logical authenticated peer frame payload; excludes framing headers/credit and SCTP/DTLS/IP overhead.

qualification: Actual fresh Chromium/OPFS enrollment, authenticated RTC history, writer and reader revocation, Worker replacement, durable administrator reopen and newly keyed read-only recovery with zero application-envelope bytes to the administrator.
limits: The validator checks declared observations; the workflow supplies execution evidence.
The native handler reports accepted:3 and failed:2. This report has no terminal-error attribution; those counters are preserved without claiming an error-free lifecycle.
Peer traffic counts logical authenticated frame payloads and excludes framing, credit and SCTP/DTLS/IP overhead.
The administrator scans descriptor/control history during participant operations; this is not sparse-proof verification.
Loopback and synthetic host accounts do not establish public NAT, deployed identity-provider behavior, TURN or provider billing.
